2609.31062.title: CG-Probes: Recovering Guardrail Directions from Patient Query Embeddings
2609.31062.paper_summary: Patient-facing AI assistants promise valuable support to patients, but incoming queries can pose medical risks. To create guardrails, we work with oncologists to define three ordinal risk axes: Medical Urgency, Psychological Urgency, and Topic Sensitivity. We propose Clinical Guardrail Probes (CG-Probes) to measure the risks from query embeddings. We probe for each axis in the normalized embedding space of frozen embedders via the difference-in-means method, treating each axis as a potential linear direction. To train the probes, we cluster 79,658 Czech oncology search queries with BERTopic and use these clusters to generate pairs of queries with contrastive risk levels via few-shot prompting. We evaluate the approach on 200 queries (90 real, 110 synthetic), each graded by two oncologists, against two open-weight LLMs and a frontier LLM. We find that urgency-based axes are recoverable as linear directions, and the probes are competitive with open-weight LLMs (no significant differences in quadratic-weighted kappa) at a fraction of the latency. Each axis yields a scalar score that clinicians can inspect and use to set escalation thresholds. The pipeline requires only search logs, axis definitions, and black-box access to the embedding model, suggesting transferability across healthcare domains. Robust validation on new queries and axes remains future work.
2609.31062.paper_summary_zh: 病人面對的 AI 助手承諾為病人提供有價值的支持，但進來的查詢可能會帶來醫療風險。為了創建防護措施，我們與腫瘤科醫生合作定義三個序數風險軸：醫療緊急性、心理緊急性和主題敏感性。我們提出臨床防護探針（CG-Probes）來測量查詢嵌入的風險。我們通過均值差異法在凍結嵌入器的標準化嵌入空間中對每個軸進行探測，將每個軸視為潛在的線性方向。為了訓練探針，我們使用 BERTopic 對 79,658 條捷克腫瘤學搜索查詢進行聚類，並利用這些聚類通過少量提示生成具有對比風險水平的查詢對。我們在 200 條查詢（90 條真實查詢，110 條合成查詢）上評估該方法，每條查詢由兩位腫瘤科醫生進行評分，並與兩個開放權重的 LLM 和一個前沿 LLM 進行比較。我們發現基於緊急性的軸可以作為線性方向恢復，並且探針在延遲的一小部分下與開放權重的 LLM 具有競爭力（在二次加權 kappa 上沒有顯著差異）。每個軸產生一個標量分數，臨床醫生可以檢查並用來設置升級閾值。該流程僅需要搜索日誌、軸定義和對嵌入模型的黑箱訪問，這表明其在醫療保健領域的可轉移性。對新查詢和軸的穩健驗證仍然是未來的工作。
